title: The Secret of the Moon Kingdom
synopsis: The golden star opens a moon portal, and Lumi, Bobo and Draco arrive in the Moon Kingdom, a silver castle floating above the clouds. Its guardian Moonia says the Moon Crystal is lost and the lights are fading; the friends find it trapped in a bubble inside a moon flower, and the golden star's light frees it, so the whole kingdom shines again. Helping others makes the world brighter.
ending: Moonia gives Lumi a glowing moon pendant, and it projects a shimmering underwater kingdom into the air. Where will it lead?
newCharacters: Moonia, the small glowing silver-blue guardian of the Moon Kingdom, with big eyes, tiny gold stars on her body and a crescent-moon crest (Moonia in src/ep05/props.tsx)
